doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21

title: Alfred Laine: playing with Jimmy Durante and his band Baby Lane
summary: Jack's son Alfred, 56, says he played with Jimmy Durante in New York at 19 and led his own band, Baby Lane, started by his father, on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: This is Alfred John Lane. I'm talking about 531 Cluett Street for my daddy right now, and he and I was just now talking, and we were talking about things gone by years ago. Of course, I'm 56 years old today. I'm not a young man, and I was with Jimmy Durante when I was 19 years old. I was in New York playing with Jimmy Durante. I don't think I have much more to say to you, but nevertheless...
Well, didn't you have your own band while your daddy's was called?
Oh, yeah, and I had my band, Baby Lane. My daddy got a band for me, and he started me out playing, so I played with my dad. What instruments did you play? I played a trumpet.
Any other instruments? Well, yeah. I, yeah, yeah. I, yeah, yeah. I, yeah, yeah.
